summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei is reported martyred with funeral preparations underway in Tehran and Iraq. Israeli forces eliminate a Hezbollah operative in southern Lebanon and report 83% of Gaza border tunnels destroyed. A drone attack hits an Iranian Kurdish camp in Erbil while clashes continue on the Iran-Iraq border.
key_points: Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei reported martyred; funeral ceremonies planned in Tehran and Iraq's Najaf and Karbala with millions expected. (Source: @presstv/196596)
IDF eliminates Hezbollah terrorist exiting underground infrastructure at Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon. (Source: @idf_telegram/24500)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz states 83% of tunnels in Gaza's yellow line area have been destroyed. (Source: @yediotnews25/132224)
Drone attack targets Iranian Kurdish opposition camp in Koy Sanjaq, Erbil; IRGC clashes with Kurdish groups near Sardasht and Piranshahr. (Source: @VahidOnline/76769)
Explosion at Damascus cafe near Palace of Justice kills 4-9 and injures 10-20; Syrian ministry attributes to 1kg IED with metal shrapnel. (Source: @N12chat/215703)
Tajik citizen with Russian passport arrested in Israel for spying for Iran during 'Roar of the Lion' operation. (Source: @pkpoi/143104)
European countries agree ships transiting Hormuz will pay fees to Iran and Oman; US offers sanctions relief for full strait access. (Source: @asafroz/50936)
Red alerts sounded in Avivim and Yir'on on Israel-Lebanon border; IDF later calls them false alarms. (Source: @New_security8200/202196)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei is reported martyred, triggering massive funeral preparations in Tehran and Iraq while leadership transition uncertainties emerge. Israeli forces maintain pressure on Hezbollah in southern Lebanon with targeted killings and weapons cache discoveries, while claiming 83% destruction of Gaza border tunnels. Regional tensions escalate with drone attacks on Iranian Kurdish groups in Iraq, a deadly Damascus explosion, and competing diplomatic moves over the Strait of Hormuz.

points: Iranian state media reports Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei martyred; funeral processions scheduled in Tehran near Imam Khomeini Husseiniyeh and in Iraq's Najaf and Karbala with millions expected to attend. (Source: @presstv/196588, @presstv/196596, @naya_foriraq/80624)

IRGC Commander Ahmad Vahidi appears publicly for first time since war began at meeting with President, Parliament Speaker Qalibaf, and senior officials to coordinate funeral arrangements. (Source: @asafroz/50935, @N12chat/215704)

Parliament Speaker Qalibaf denies reports of IAEA inspector access to damaged nuclear sites, citing law and Supreme National Security Council decision limiting access to Bushehr plant and Tehran reactor only. (Source: @VahidOnline/76771)

Clashes between IRGC and Kurdish armed groups continue near Sardasht and Piranshahr in West Azerbaijan province; KDPI reports 5 killed in Qazqapan village, Fars claims 6 KDPI dead, Sabereen News claims 11 opposition fighters killed. (Source: @VahidOnline/76769)

Drone attack hits Iranian Kurdish opposition camp in Koy Sanjaq, east of Erbil; explosions also reported in Erbil and Sulaymaniyah including Freedom Party HQ allegedly struck by ballistic missile. (Source: @VahidOnline/76769)
US intelligence suspected Israel planned to assassinate negotiators Qalibaf and Araghchi during April talks; Washington asked third countries to warn Iran. (Source: @New_security8200/202202)
Trump claims Iran faces 300% inflation with no revenue; threatens to take Iranian funds and supply US farmers exclusively. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74648)

IDF Egoz Unit under Division 36 identifies and eliminates Hezbollah operative exiting underground tunnel shaft at Ali Taher ridge in security zone; airstrike directed by ground forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24500)

Division 91 operations in southern Lebanon: Brigade 401 discovers tunnel shaft and weapons cache with rockets and mortars in Aita al-Shaab; Reserve Brigade Yiftach (679) finds explosives, weapons in Maroun al-Ras. (Source: @New_security8200/202190)
Defense Minister Katz announces 83% of tunnels in Gaza's yellow line area destroyed during 'Roar of the Lion' operation. (Source: @yediotnews25/132224, @inon_yttach/9257)
IDF thwarts car-ramming attempt near Beit Ummar in Etzion Brigade; no casualties; forces pursue suspects and search area. (Source: @idf_telegram/24498, @inon_yttach/9250, @yediotnews25/132209)
Red alerts activated for Avivim and Yir'on on confrontation line (15-second warning); IDF later reports false alarm. (Source: @New_security8200/202196, @tzevaadom_en/68509, @inon_yttach/9256)

Tajik national with Russian passport arrested by Shin Bet and Malmab for spying for Iran during 'Roar of the Lion'; documented missile impacts, Azrieli Towers coordinates, Haifa Port, attempted to photograph northern sensitive facility. (Source: @pkpoi/143104, @inon_yttach/9248)
'Purple rain' alert declared for IDF in all villages near border in central sector. (Source: @pkpoi/143117)
Defense Minister Katz reports 83% of tunnels in Gaza's yellow line area destroyed, indicating significant degradation of Hamas underground infrastructure. (Source: @yediotnews25/132224)
Car-ramming attempt near Beit Ummar in West Bank's Etzion Brigade thwarted by IDF; no injuries; suspects pursued. (Source: @idf_telegram/24498)
Israeli civilian activist charged for blocking aid trucks to Gaza; protests continue against humanitarian aid transfers. (Source: @yediotnews25/132216)
Hezbollah operative eliminated by IDF after exiting underground infrastructure at Ali Taher ridge; forces prevent movement from tunnel network. (Source: @idf_telegram/24500)
IDF uncovers tunnel shaft and rocket/mortar cache in Aita al-Shaab; explosives and weapons found in Maroun al-Ras during Division 91 operations. (Source: @New_security8200/202190)
Airstrike reported on Barashit in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/29554)
Drone strike near hospital in Nabatieh, southern Lebanon. (Source: @yediotnews25/132218)
Two seriously wounded reported in exchange of fire between Israeli forces and Hezbollah elements in south Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374101)
Red alerts in Avivim and Yir'on proven false; 'purple rain' alert issued for central sector border villages. (Source: @New_security8200/202196, @inon_yttach/9256, @pkpoi/143117)

Explosion at cafe near Palace of Justice in Damascus: Faytuks Network reports 4 dead, 11 injured; Syrian Interior Ministry says 9 civilians killed, 20 injured from 1kg IED with metal shrapnel. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4570, @N12chat/215703)
Iraq expects millions to attend Khamenei funeral ceremonies in Najaf and Karbala. (Source: @presstv/196596)
Drone attack on Iranian Kurdish opposition camp in Koy Sanjaq, Erbil; details still emerging. (Source: @VahidOnline/76769)
IRGC clashes with Kurdish armed groups near Sardasht and Piranshahr; multiple casualties reported on both sides. (Source: @VahidOnline/76769)
Explosions in Erbil and Sulaymaniyah; Freedom Party HQ allegedly hit by ballistic missile. (Source: @VahidOnline/76769)
European countries agree ships transiting Strait of Hormuz will pay fees to Iran and Oman. (Source: @asafroz/50936)
US offers Iran unfrozen funds in exchange for full opening of Hormuz without insurance fees; Iran currently refuses. (Source: @pkpoi/143111, @amitsegal/62722)
Oman reports 38 ships passed Hormuz under 'Physicians-Trump agreement': 7 via Iran (6 Iranian, 1 Iraqi), 16 via Oman. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74641)
Trump states Iran faces 300% inflation, no revenue; US intends to take Iranian funds and supply American farmers exclusively. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74648)

sections.threat_assessment: The reported death of Supreme Leader Khamenei creates a critical leadership vacuum in Iran at a time of heightened regional tension. Simultaneous Israeli operations in Lebanon and Gaza, Iranian-Kurdish clashes on the Iraq border, and competing Hormuz diplomacy indicate multi-axis instability. The arrest of an Iranian-directed spy inside Israel during active conflict demonstrates persistent intelligence penetration. False alarms on northern border and 'purple rain' alerts suggest elevated force protection posture. Any succession struggle in Tehran could trigger IRGC escalation or fragmentation, directly affecting proxy coordination across Lebanon, Iraq, Syria, and Yemen.
sections.regional_response: Iraq prepares massive funeral attendance signaling continued alignment with Iran's axis. European states accepting Hormuz transit fees to Iran and Oman marks significant sanctions erosion. US offer to unfreeze funds for strait access reveals strategic priority on maritime security over maximum pressure. Oman's increased shipping share under new arrangement indicates Gulf realignment. Syrian investigation into Damascus bombing may reveal internal security gaps. Lebanese Hezbollah absorbs tactical losses while maintaining tunnel infrastructure. Israeli domestic debate over aid blockade prosecutions reflects societal strain.
sections.intelligence_notes: Conflicting casualty reports from Damascus explosion (4 vs 9 dead) indicate information control or evolving assessment. Iranian Kurdish groups claim 5 dead, IRGC-aligned media claims 6-11 opposition killed — discrepancy suggests propaganda shaping. Qalibaf's categorical denial of IAEA access to damaged sites confirms nuclear red lines remain despite leadership transition. US warning to Iran about alleged Israeli assassination plot reveals deep intelligence sharing and concern for diplomatic channel integrity. Tajik spy's Russian passport highlights continued use of Central Asian cutouts. 'Purple rain' alert terminology suggests new IDF threat classification for drone/missile saturation.
